description.value: Fairway Market is a locally owned Vancouver Island grocery chain founded in 1963, now operating nine locations including this Saanich store on McKenzie Avenue. As one of the island's largest independent grocers, it stocks a broad range of departments — produce, dairy, meat, bakery, deli, and dedicated Asian Kitchen and Sushi Village counters. The chain emphasizes local BC and Canadian producers alongside international specialties, making it a well-stocked resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through Victoria's eastern suburbs.
